# Wide characters and grapheme clusters. Multi-byte input is spelled as
# UTF-8 bytes; screen rows hold the cluster text.

=== A wide character takes two cells
source: Unicode UAX #11 (East Asian Wide); xterm wide-character support
input: \xe4\xb8\xadab
cursor: 1,5
screen:
|中ab......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A wide character that does not fit wraps whole
source: foot and Alacritty (leading spacer at the end of the line)
size: 5x2
input: abcd\xe4\xb8\xad
cursor: 2,3
screen:
|abcd.|
|中...|

=== Writing over the second half of a wide character blanks the first
source: xterm wide-character handling (no half characters)
input: \xe4\xb8\xad\e[1;2Hx
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|.x........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== Writing over the first half of a wide character blanks the second
source: xterm wide-character handling (no half characters)
input: \xe4\xb8\xad\e[1;1Hx
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|x.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A combining mark joins the previous cell
source: Unicode UAX #29 (GB9, Extend)
input: e\xcc\x81x
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|éx........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A combining mark in the pending wrap joins the last column
source: Unicode UAX #29 (GB9); xterm ctlseqs DECAWM
input: 123456789e\xcc\x81
cursor: 1,10 wrap
screen:
|123456789é|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A combining mark with nothing to join is dropped
source: Unicode UAX #29; xterm drops combining marks at the line start
input: \xcc\x81a
cursor: 1,2
screen:
|a.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A ZWJ sequence is one cluster as wide as its first code point
source: Unicode UAX #29 (GB11); mode 2027 off by default
input: \xf0\x9f\x91\xa8\xe2\x80\x8d\xf0\x9f\x91\xa9x
cursor: 1,4
screen:
|👨‍👩x.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== VS16 does not widen a narrow character without mode 2027
source: Unicode UTS #51 (emoji presentation); mode 2027 off by default
input: \xe2\x9d\xa4\xef\xb8\x8fx
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|❤️x........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== A control between code points ends the cluster
source: Unicode UAX #29 (GB4, GB5)
input: e\e[C\xcc\x81
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|e.........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
